_comment: Public, non-secret defaults for Node.js hosts (Replit) — read by server.js.
These used to live in wrangler.jsonc 'vars', but a vars entry collides with a
Cloudflare Pages secret of the same name and makes the deploy fail with
"Binding name '<NAME>' already in use". Keeping them here lets Cloudflare use
pure secrets while Node hosts still have working defaults.
Safe to commit: the anon/publishable keys are client-side keys protected by
Supabase Row Level Security, and STORE_ID is a public storefront id.
Set those as Replit Secrets / Cloudflare Pages secrets. process.env always
takes priority over this file, so any value can be overridden per host.
